description: This file defines an abstract class `SynthVoice` serving as a base for polyphonic synthesizer voices, providing common functionality such as note handling, amplitude setting, mixing, and rendering interface.

classes.name: SynthVoice
classes.description: Base class for a polyphonic synthesizer voice with note management and audio mixing capabilities.

methods.name: noteOn
methods.description: Activates the voice with a given note index and velocity, setting its amplitude accordingly.

methods.name: noteOff
methods.description: Deactivates the voice, marking it as off.

methods.name: mix
methods.description: Adds the output of this voice to a provided output buffer over a specified number of samples per frame, scaled by level.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Abstract method to generate the current sample of audio for this voice.

methods.name: isDone
methods.description: Checks if the voice is currently in the off state.

methods.name: getNoteIndex
methods.description: Returns the current note index this voice is playing.

methods.name: getAmplitude
methods.description: Returns the current amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setAmplitude
methods.description: Sets the amplitude of the voice.

methods.name: setFrequencyScaler
methods.description: Adjusts the frequency scaling factor; placeholder implementation.
